focus: Data & analytics engineering, machine learning, and business intelligence
work_mode: Remote roles, contracts, and paid project work

lanes.title: Data & analytics engineering
lanes.question: Can the data be traced from source to a decision-ready model?
lanes.look_for: Source handling, transformation rules, model grain, validation steps, and operational documentation.

lanes.title: Machine learning & search intelligence
lanes.question: How are features, evaluation, and a useful output connected?
lanes.look_for: Dataset preparation, leakage-aware evaluation, notebooks, and interfaces that explain a model’s use.

lanes.title: Business intelligence & automation
lanes.question: Can another person understand the KPI and repeat the workflow?
lanes.look_for: Report previews, semantic models, documented definitions, and repeatable automation patterns.
